styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.DEOKGEUM: a woman in her fifties, hair wrapped in a plain cloth, gray hemp jacket with rolled sleeves and a dark work skirt, no ornament, never silk
characters.BONGSU: a burly blacksmith in his forties, topknot with a headband, leather apron over a gray jacket, bare forearms
characters.MAGISTRATE: the county magistrate, a dignified man with a short beard in a crimson official robe and black official hat

scenes.S01: A close view filling the whole frame: a heap of broken iron farm tools piled on bare earth, snapped curved sickle blades and hoe heads separated from their wooden handles, seen from above. The heap fills the frame. No people, no hands, no wall, no sky.
scenes.S02: DEOKGEUM standing in a county office courtyard holding up a broken sickle blade at eye height with both hands and pointing at its broken end, her face calm and firm. A magistrate in a crimson robe and several village men stand around her staring. Daylight.

scenes.S06: Exactly two people in a village smithy: a young blacksmith in a leather apron swinging a hammer on an anvil, and a young woman working the foot bellows behind him, the forge glowing between them. Nobody else.

scenes.S21: Only one person in the picture: DEOKGEUM standing alone in the middle of a county office courtyard in a gray hemp jacket and head cloth, her back straight, her hands folded in front of her. Daylight, nobody else.
